intuition: A pattern and sentence correspond when their words form a bijection with pattern characters.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate possible word groupings and check whether each grouping follows the pattern.

optimal.approach: Split the sentence and verify simultaneous character-to-word and word-to-character mappings.

edge_cases: The number of words must equal the number of pattern characters.
Repeated pattern characters must repeat the same word.
Different pattern characters cannot map to the same word.
